items.html:
Implemented transparent array-function dispatch across special, coeffs, sw, cw, pw, lattice sums, and material helpers.

  • Shared callable wrapper preserves NumPy behavior, ufunc attributes/methods, introspection, and public pickling.
  • Reuses existing analytic records across Advect, JAX, PyTorch, and Autograd.
  • 1,538 tests passed, 22 expected skips; four additional complex-gradient convention tests passed. Ruff, Pyrefly, and diff checks passed.
  • Measured NumPy overhead: approximately 0.4–0.7 µs per small call.

Documented limits: differentiated out/where and ufunc methods; independent periodic-to-plane wavevector derivatives; cw.to_sw axial derivatives; fractional-degree lpmv derivatives. Genuine numpy.ufunc identity changes to a callable wrapper.

No builds, installations, commits, pushes, or release coordination performed.
